# Dropdown

Dropdowns let people pick one or several options from a list. Two sizes, three field variants, error and feedback states, single and multi select with checkboxes, and the library's signature press line that grows across the field's bottom edge when open. Ported from the DGA library's dga-dropdown component.

**Stylesheet:** `components/dropdown/dropdown.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/dropdown.js` (classes `DropdownManager`). Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes for configuring dropdowns, mapped from the library's dga-dropdown API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.dropdown` | Base | — | Positioning container for the trigger button and the options list. |
| .dropdown--lg / --md | Modifier | `size` | Field heights 40px / 32px; the list opens below the field accordingly. |
| .dropdown--lighter / --darker | Modifier | `variant` | Borderless variants: lighter is transparent, darker sits on a gray-100 fill. Both regain their border on hover and open. |
| .dropdown--error / --readonly / --disabled | State | error, readonly, disabled | Error recolors the border and press line; read-only and disabled mute the field and ignore interaction. |
| `.dropdown--multi-select` | Modifier | `multi-select` | Options render 24px checkboxes; the trigger joins selections with commas. |
| .dropdown__btn [+ .open, .active] | Element | — | The trigger. Open rotates the chevron and grows the bottom press line to full width; active (pressed) shows it at 50%. |
| .dropdown__label / __label-placeholder | Element | `placeholder` | Adding --selection to the label shows it and hides the placeholder. |
| .dropdown__list / __list-group / __list-group-label | Element | `option-list` | The floating listbox (max 376px, styled scrollbar) with optional grouped sections. |
| .dropdown__option [+ .selected, --checkbox] | Element | — | Option row. Selected shows a trailing tick, or fills the leading checkbox in multi select. |
| `.dropdown__feedback-icon--success\|--error\|--warning` | Element | `feedback` | Status icon inside the field with a soft tinted halo. |

## Default

Click the field to open it. Choosing an option fills the trigger label and shows a tick next to the selection.

```html
<div class="dropdown-field" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <span class="dropdown-field__label">Region</span>
    <div class="dropdown dropdown--lg">
        <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
            <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Select a region</span>
            <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox">
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option">
                    <span class="dropdown__option-label">Riyadh</span>
                    <span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span>
                </button></li>
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option">
                    <span class="dropdown__option-label">Makkah</span>
                    <span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span>
                </button></li>
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option">
                    <span class="dropdown__option-label">Madinah</span>
                    <span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span>
                </button></li>
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option">
                    <span class="dropdown__option-label">Eastern Province</span>
                    <span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span>
                </button></li>
        </ul>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Variants

Lighter drops the border until interaction; darker sits on a gray fill. Both regain the default border when hovered or open.

    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Default</span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox">
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option"><span class="dropdown__option-label">Option
                    A</span><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></button></li>

## Validation & States

Error outlines the field and recolors the press line; a feedback icon with a tinted halo can sit before the chevron. Read-only and disabled mute the field.

```html
<div class="dropdown dropdown--lg dropdown--error" style="max-width: 220px;">
    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Error</span>
        <span class="dropdown__feedback-icon dropdown__feedback-icon--error"><span class="icon dga-icon-cancel-circle"></span></span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox">
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option"><span class="dropdown__option-label">Option
                    A</span><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></button></li>
    </ul>
</div>
<div class="dropdown dropdown--lg" style="max-width: 220px;">
    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="dropdown__label dropdown__label--selection">Riyadh</span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Success</span>
        <span class="dropdown__feedback-icon dropdown__feedback-icon--success"><span class="icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02"></span></span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox">
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option selected"><span class="dropdown__option-label">Riyadh</span><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></button></li>
    </ul>
</div>
<div class="dropdown dropdown--lg dropdown--readonly" style="max-width: 220px;">
    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" disabled="">
        <span class="dropdown__label dropdown__label--selection">Read-only value</span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder"></span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox"></ul>
</div>
<div class="dropdown dropdown--lg dropdown--disabled" style="max-width: 220px;">
    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" disabled="">
        <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Disabled</span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox"></ul>
</div>
```

## Multi Select

Options carry 24px checkboxes and stay open while choosing; the trigger joins the selections with commas.

```html
<div class="dropdown dropdown--lg dropdown--multi-select" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
        <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">Select services</span>
        <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
    <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true">
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option dropdown__option--checkbox">
                <span class="dropdown__option-icon-container"><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></span>
                <span class="dropdown__option-label">Digital certificates</span>
            </button></li>
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option dropdown__option--checkbox">
                <span class="dropdown__option-icon-container"><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></span>
                <span class="dropdown__option-label">E-payments</span>
            </button></li>
        <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option dropdown__option--checkbox">
                <span class="dropdown__option-icon-container"><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></span>
                <span class="dropdown__option-label">Document verification</span>
            </button></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## RTL Layout

The field, chevron, and options mirror in right-to-left layouts.

```html
<div class="dropdown-field" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <span class="dropdown-field__label">المنطقة</span>
    <div class="dropdown dropdown--lg">
        <button type="button" class="dropdown__btn" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="dropdown__label"></span>
            <span class="dropdown__label-placeholder">اختر منطقة</span>
            <span class="dropdown__chevron icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
        <ul class="dropdown__list" role="listbox">
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option"><span class="dropdown__option-label">الرياض</span><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></button></li>
            <li><button type="button" class="dropdown__option"><span class="dropdown__option-label">مكة
                        المكرمة</span><span class="dropdown__option-icon icon dga-icon-tick-02"></span></button>
            </li>
        </ul>
    </div>
</div>
```
